zone.description: Built-in trusted zone, overridden here only to statically bind docker0 and incusbr0. Binding them in this file (not just via a one-time firewall-cmd --change-interface at bootstrap) makes the assignment survive firewalld reloads/restarts and reboots: without a static binding, every reload re-reads the zone XML files and, if docker0 were ever claimed by another zone file, would snap it back to that zone - which is exactly what a REJECT-target docker.xml used to do, breaking Docker/Incus networking and forcing a manual change-interface + reload after every restart. Do not reintroduce a docker.xml (or any other zone file) that also claims docker0/incusbr0 - only one zone file may own an interface.
